scope_summary: Phase B1 completes the implemented-code repairs from the Phase A static review and adds the design §9 in-repo behavior suite; it does not execute Linux CI and does not claim task completion. The production chain now has the exact generated unary-replacement server-stream signatures, app emitter versus wire sender separation, first Send-error precedence, success nil handling, flood-wait-first streaming mapping, safe nil/wrapper media resolution, and the required context checkpoints. Tests now cover A1 through both RPCs over real app/transport/generated client on bufconn, false startup mode, the fixed PROGRESSIVE_PAYLOAD_BEFORE_COMPLETION red-path marker, A2 prefix/bounds/cap/backpressure, A3 cancellation/deadline/send-failure/shared-reader cases, A4 terminal/EOF/error cases, and A5 media/MIME/nil/validation/error mappings. The remaining Linux mutation script, cgo-free client smoke, TEST-MATRIX accounting, CI execution, and live acceptance remain outside this implementer scope.

changes.intent: Replaced the two obsolete unary responses with FileDownloadEvent, FileDownloadMetadata, FileDownloadChunk, and FileDownloadComplete and made both RPCs server-streaming.
Regenerated for the replaced unreleased protocol contract.
Regenerated for two server-stream methods with generated grpc.ServerStreaming signatures.
Added GetFile, GetFileDownloadedPrefixSize, and ReadFilePart to clientAdapter and Repo with flood-wait translation; DownloadFile and receiver ownership remain unchanged.
Hand-added only the three new adapter methods in the existing generated style.
Added passthrough coverage for the three new file primitives alongside the existing download flood-wait test.
Extended the app repo interface with the three live file primitives and removed the obsolete path-only download methods.

Added app DTOs, media resolution, and progressive orchestration: async start, metadata, state-before-prefix, bounded read, synchronous callback backpressure, completion/unknown-size/inactive rules, timers, and context checks without upstream cancellation.
Hand-added only the three new file-primitive methods in the existing generated style.
Replaced obsolete ticket-added path-only test calls and added focused progressive success, media resolution, missing-file, async-start binding, and state-failure coverage.
Updated facadeService signatures and removed obsolete unary download handlers while preserving all unrelated behavior.

Aligned handlers with the generated two-argument server-stream interface, split app and wire callbacks, locked first-send errors, returned explicit success nil, and restored flood-wait precedence before stable download failures.
Replaced only the two download mock signatures with streaming signatures and added the facade import.
Replaced obsolete unary download tests and completed the fake ServerStream implementation; added full-interface compile assertion, stream-context mapping, and flood-wait status evidence.

Added Phase B behavior evidence for bounds, unknown-size remaining bytes, empty files, completion races, callback backpressure, synctest cancellation/deadline, shared-file independent readers, and safe nil media resolution.
Completed all eight media/MIME mappings and largest-middle-photo assertion; retained strict async start and failure mappings.

Added the required A1 bufconn test for both RPCs, barrier-gated completion, nonempty pre-release payload with diagnostic marker, false startup assertion, validation/send-failure/stable-error cases, and a native remaining-bytes fake model.
